segments.ja195:1.1: Pabbatūpatthare [pabbatapatthare (sī. syā. pī.)] ramme, jātā pokkharaṇī sivā;
segments.ja195:1.3: Taṃ siṅgālo apāpāyi [apāpāsi (sī. syā. pī.)], jānaṃ sīhena rakkhitaṃ.
segments.ja195:2.1: Pivanti ce [pivanti ve (sī.), pivantiva (pī.), pivanteva (?)] mahārāja, sāpadāni mahānadiṃ;
segments.ja195:2.3: Na tena anadī hoti, khamassu yadi te piyāti.
